title: 2023 Panini Select - Premier Level Silver Prizm Die-Cut #141 Lucas Havrisik (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select card features Lucas Havrisik of the Los Angeles Rams. The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. It is an original, not a licensed reprint, and is part of the base set with a silver prizm die-cut parallel/variety. 

The card is from the National Football League (NFL) and is a rookie card for the 2023 season. It is in English language and manufactured by Panini in the United States. The card number is 141 and it is a standard size sports trading card. This card is a great addition to any football fan's collection.
